project_extensions.scope: Research provenance, reproducibility, and independent physical checks

acceptance_criteria: Signed independent shifted-numerator and analytic PV agree within 1e-55 across physical masses and reference scales.
45 versus 65 working-digit shift drift less than 1e-40.
Zero mixing, equal masses, real physical pole, and auxiliary equal-mass threshold checks pass.
Bound heavy asymptotic remainder and distinguish fixed from falling mixing.
Byte-identical replay and actual locked standards and RCRPS v1.0.1 validation pass.
